title: 東京大賞典の後に・トップ→トップ！

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! You were all amazing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Listen to those cheers…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone looks so happy. We gave it our all, and they felt our energy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just ahead of the winning concert, Smart Falcon falls oddly silent. Is she nervous about performing on such a big stage? Or is it…

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Falcon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're…

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sorry to bother you just before the concert, but I just wanted to say… thank you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? For what?

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: You're that "Umadol," right? You've done so much to liven up the dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, there are more people here than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I've never seen such an enthusiastic crowd. It feels great!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: That's all I wanted to say. Now let's make this a concert to remember!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Yeah! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It sure was. But…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I'm totally focused.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's time for me to go, Trainer! I'm going to give this performance my heart and soul!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out of all the dirt races so far, this winning concert is by far the most memorable—truly incredible on all fronts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Smart Falcon's first words upon returning from the concert are…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm so frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Super frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Super-duper frustrated! Ugh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rack my brain for some flaw in the concert or race, but come up empty…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I just realized something.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …I've reached the top of dirt racing. This is it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The moment I got up on that stage… I couldn't have been happier.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've been onstage countless times, but I almost never feel that kind of electricity in the air.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But this isn't really the top—not the real one!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And yet… everyone seems content with how things are.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I've never seen such an enthusiastic crowd. It feels great!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This isn't right. There's so much more we could do!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We have what it takes to bring the heat, enough heat to rival the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see now where her frustration is coming from. After experiencing the top stage of both turf and dirt, she can't help but compare the two.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …I guess it's all up to me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You said my work as an Umadol affected today's turnout. That other runner did too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That means with enough hard work, we can make things even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I have to aim for the very top… of everything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our goal has always been to reach the top, so nothing has changed. And yet, Smart Falcon looks a little on edge.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What do you mean? I'm fired up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And your job is to say, "Let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her eyes tell me she's serious. As her trainer, it's my responsibility to keep an eye on her condition, and intervene if necessary.
choice_data_list: All I ask is that you don't go overboard.
All I ask is that you don't go overboard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I know. Self-discipline is one of the fundamentals of being an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So what's next? Let's figure out our next race goal!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My next race won't have the prestige of being last race of the year. That means it's totally up to me to make things even more exciting than today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do have a suggestion for her—a G1 race exclusive to senior-year racers…
choice_data_list: The February Stakes could be a good choice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's at Tokyo Racecourse, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Same as the Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are two dirt G1 races in the Twinkle Series—the February Stakes and Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Naturally, these two races have better coverage compared to those at regional racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Got it. Let's give the February Stakes a go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon has an air of determination about her. Her first race as a senior will officially be the February Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: This my chance to really stand out… which means I've gotta take it!
